import boto3
from moto import mock_sagemaker

@mock_sagemaker
def main():
    c = boto3.client("sagemaker", region_name="us-east-1")
    role = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/service-role/SageMakerRole"
    for i in range(5):
        c.create_notebook_instance(NotebookInstanceName=f"nb{i}", InstanceType="ml.t2.xlarge", RoleArn=role)
    r = c.list_notebook_instances()
    assert len(r["NotebookInstances"]) == 5
    p = c.get_paginator("list_notebook_instances")
    pages = list(p.paginate(PaginationConfig={"PageSize": 2}))
    assert [len(pg["NotebookInstances"]) for pg in pages] == [2, 2, 1]
    names = [i["NotebookInstanceName"] for pg in pages for i in pg["NotebookInstances"]]
    assert names == [f"nb{i}" for i in range(5)], names
    r = c.list_notebook_instances(NameContains="nb1")
    assert [i["NotebookInstanceName"] for i in r["NotebookInstances"]] == ["nb1"]
    r = c.list_notebook_instances(SortBy="Name", SortOrder="Descending")
    assert r["NotebookInstances"][0]["NotebookInstanceName"] == "nb4"
    r = c.list_notebook_instances(StatusEquals="InService")
    assert len(r["NotebookInstances"]) == 5
    c.stop_notebook_instance(NotebookInstanceName="nb0")
    r = c.list_notebook_instances(StatusEquals="Stopped")
    assert [i["NotebookInstanceName"] for i in r["NotebookInstances"]] == ["nb0"]
    print("OK")

main()
